subject: Interim tranche invoicing - conditional quarterly cycle & holdback approval
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@pioneeredge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Harris <tharris@pioneeredge.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim tranche invoicing + conditional quarterly billing

Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — PioneerEdge is excited about the integration with Redwood's routing policies. Before we move to contract, Procurement has a couple of asks on invoicing we need confirmed in writing: 

1) Split invoicing across three tranches tied to delivery milestones (T+30/T+60/T+90 from signature).
2) Quarterly consolidated invoices for our internal AP team (they prefer one quarterly statement rather than monthly line items).
3) A 5% 60-day holdback on final tranche until post-production validation (our standard).

Attached is a short payment plan proposal and the latest SOW with delivery milestones. Can Redwood confirm whether you can accept this structure (Net-60 on tranche 2 and Net-90 on tranche 3 with quarterly consolidated statements)? If you need an exec sign-off or a one-off invoice cadence, please let us know the process and timeline.

Appreciate it — we want to get to signature by end of September.

Best,
Samantha Lowe
CFO, PioneerEdge
Attachment: Payment_Plan_Proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: PioneerEdge_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@pioneeredge.com>

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: interim tranche invoicing + conditional quarterly billing

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear outline and the docs.

Quick read: the tranche / milestone approach looks fine from a product-delivery perspective. The billing asks (quarterly consolidated statements + holdback) are non-standard and require finance + deal desk approval. Looping in Aditya (AM) and our Billing lead Laura for the specifics. We'll confirm next steps by Friday.

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Work: 415-555-0112

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: interim tranche invoicing + conditional quarterly billing

Team — forwarding PioneerEdge's ask. Summary of what they want:
- 3 tranches tied to milestones (ok on delivery)
- Quarterly consolidated invoices (non-standard; adds reconciliation work)
- 5% holdback on final tranche, Net-60/Net-90 on later tranches (finance approval required)

Potential impacts: cashflow push (Net-90), accounting overhead for consolidated quarterlies, and a legal clause around holdback release conditions. Billing prefers to avoid Net-90 where possible; finance will want compensation/credit or a pricing uplift.

Can Finance/legal confirm whether we can: 
A) Accept Net-60 on tranche 2 and Net-90 on tranche 3 with a signed holdback clause, and
B) Issue a single consolidated invoice per quarter covering any tranches that fall in that quarter (format to be agreed).

Marissa — can you advise whether this needs exec (VP Finance) approval or if you can OK with deal desk controls? If yes, please specify any pricing or credit conditions.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Exec Manager

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: interim tranche invoicing + conditional quarterly billing

Team — reviewed PioneerEdge's proposal and attached SOW. Two points from Finance: 
1) Net-90 is high risk for us on a new account; we can accept Net-60 on tranche 2 but require either an escrow/ACH pre-authorized payment for tranche 3 OR a 2% contract price uplift to offset DSO.
2) Consolidated quarterly statements are workable, but we need a clause that ties Redwood's invoice dates to calendar quarter end and the AP team to provide a single remittance per quarter. We'll require the customer to accept an invoice format (sample attached) and a PO reference per quarter.

If Sales accepts the uplift or escrow option, Finance can approve this at the VP-delegation level; otherwise I need VP sign-off (Marissa_C_VP_FIN).

Laura — can your team handle the consolidated invoice generation and remittance tracking? If there is any manual work, we should capture a one-time setup fee (suggest $1,250) to cover operational overhead.

Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_QuarterlyInvoice_Sample.pdf

Marissa / Laura — following up. PioneerEdge is targeting signature by month-end and requests a final yes/no so they can present to their CFO. Sales is comfortable with either an uplift or escrow; customer's preference is to avoid uplifts.

If Finance can approve the escrow/pre-authorized payment option and the $1,250 one-time setup fee on consolidated invoices, we can move forward with no exec escalation. If VP sign-off is required, please advise and we'll route accordingly (timeline: 48 hours preferred).

To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@pioneeredge.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Fwd: Request: interim tranche invoicing + conditional quarterly billing

Hi all — quick operational check and final confirmation: 

1) Redwood Billing can produce a single consolidated invoice per calendar quarter and include the three tranches as line items when applicable. We'll require a PO number for each quarter and a signed acknowledgement of the invoice format.
2) For the final tranche, we can accept an ACH pre-authorization (escrow-style release) that triggers release after 60 days post-production validation. That meets Finance's requirement and avoids a price uplift.
3) We'll add a one-time $1,250 setup fee to the first invoice to cover manual reconciliation and mapping to PioneerEdge's AP process.

If PioneerEdge is OK with the ACH pre-authorization and the one-time setup fee, Finance has delegated approval and no VP escalation is needed. Samantha/Tom — please confirm in writing and we will update the SOW and contract terms.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_QuarterlyInvoice_Sample.pdf
